newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see nearby tapioca trade in afterno.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see nearby tapioca trade in afterno.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some trade in Thai tapioca pellets as consumers covered their nearby needs ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Little trade was reported in other products despite a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening.
"There is still little faith in the market and a strong dollar also restricted activity this afternoon," a broker said.

Afloat Thai tapioca pellets traded between 18.40 and 19.10 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam from various vessels. Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets fetched $295 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES + 31 20 504 5832
